hero.headline: The most fun way to learn a language, and much more!

free.heading: free. fun. effective.
free.text1: Learning with us is fun, and it
free.text2: ! With short, interactive lessons, earn points, level up and build real language skills for everyday situations.

coach.heading: a coach available 24/7
coach.text: Chat freely in the language you're learning. Every message is corrected, translated and explained instantly — like a real private tutor, always there when you need it.

motivation.heading: motivation that stays high
motivation.text: We help you build a practice habit with fun challenges, a daily streak, XP points, and vocabulary that saves itself automatically as you chat.

voice.heading: speak, we're listening
voice.text: Turn on the mic and speak out loud. Your pronunciation is transcribed, translated and analyzed in seconds for immersive learning, up to 3x faster.

footer.tagline: Learn languages for free. Immersive conversations and personalized tracking.
